INSERT INTO ref_manual_report_icd10_codes (manual_report_id, icd10_code) SELECT m.id, v.icd10_code FROM (VALUES ('141', 'B18'), ('141', 'B18.8'), ('141', 'B18.9'), ('157', 'J20'), ('157', 'J20.9'), ('157', 'J21'), ('157', 'J21.9') ) AS v(report_code, icd10_code) JOIN ref_manual_report m ON m.code = v.report_code AND m.deleted = FALSE WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ref_manual_report_icd10_codes c WHERE c.manual_report_id = m.id AND c.icd10_code = v.icd10_code );
DELETE FROM ref_manual_report_icd10_codes c USING ref_manual_report m WHERE m.id = c.manual_report_id AND ((m.code = '108' AND c.icd10_code = 'A03.9') OR (m.code = '202' AND c.icd10_code = 'J80'));
